target_policy: median pKi within each structure-assay group, then median of those assay medians
structure_policy: full RDKit canonical isomeric SMILES in rdkit_smiles

audit_a.policy: Distinct curated keys stay separate; fingerprints do not define structure identity.
audit_a.limitation: Canonical SMILES does not resolve all tautomer, protonation, or unspecified stereo relationships.

limitations: Scaffold disjointness does not imply low fingerprint similarity.
Shared assay and document IDs indicate context, not proven duplicate experiments.
Test reservation is protocol-specific; a structure may train one protocol and be held out in another.
No held-out target gaps or prediction metrics were inspected.

path_update.reason: Descriptive folders and filenames; original execution timestamps and scientific results retained.
